summary: The proposed patch addresses a known issue with handling signed bytes from OPeNDAP via pydap, but requires careful review to ensure it does not introduce any regressions or maintainability issues.

issues.description: The change may break existing behavior when reading variables with _Unsigned attribute but not of integer type.
Additional tests should be added to cover the new behavior and edge cases.
The use of np.asarray with a specific dtype may be considered a fragile approach, and alternative solutions should be explored.
The patch introduces a new line of code, which may not follow the project's coding conventions.
The patch does not include any documentation or comment updates to reflect the changes made.
